intro.text: The number row is the furthest reach. 1 is for your left little finger, 2 ring, 3 middle, and 4 and 5 for your index finger.
intro.tip: Reach up from the home row and come straight back – keep your eyes on the screen.

steps.title: Meet 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: I have 3 cats, 2 dogs and 1 rabbit. We need 4 eggs and 5 apples. Count to 15 slowly.
There are 52 cards in a pack. The bus left at 4 and came back at 5. Page 21 is next.
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
